# Add an item to the cart

## Requirements

1. **Item is added, case 1** (R1)
   **Given** an empty cart
   **When** the shopper adds one product
   **Then** the cart shows that product once

2. **Item is added, case 2** (R1)
   **Given** an empty cart
   **When** the shopper adds one product
   **Then** the cart shows that product once
